# BoostEZ

> 24/7 mobile car battery boost and battery replacement service in Toronto and the GTA. We come to you — home, workplace, parking lot, or roadside.

## Services

- Emergency car battery boost (jump start), from $50
- Mobile car battery replacement on-site
- 15-minute average response time, available 24/7
- No Start, No Pay: if we can't start your car, you don't pay

## Service areas

Toronto (including North York), Ajax, Markham, Oshawa, Pickering, Richmond Hill, Vaughan, and the Greater Toronto Area.

## Contact

- Phone: 437-435-1699 (call or text, 24/7)
- Website: https://www.boostez.ca/
